nose_long: The nose in `image` looks longer than the nose in `reference_image` (relative to the face).
nose_highlight_big: The highlight down the nose bridge in `image` is larger or brighter than in `reference_image`.
nose_tip_sharp: The nose tip in `image` is sharper or more pointed than in `reference_image`.
nose_tip_low: The nose tip in `image` sits lower (closer to the mouth) than in `reference_image`.
nose_shadow_weak: The small shadow under / beside the nose in `image` is weaker or missing compared with `reference_image`.
nose_ok: The nose in `image` is drawn like the nose in `reference_image`.
chin_pointed: The chin in `image` is more pointed (V-shaped) than the chin in `reference_image`.
chin_narrow: The chin and jaw in `image` are narrower than in `reference_image`.
chin_long: The chin in `image` is longer (more face below the mouth) than in `reference_image`.
chin_short: The chin in `image` is shorter or weaker than in `reference_image`.
chin_ok: The chin and jaw in `image` are shaped like the chin and jaw in `reference_image`.
eyes_small: The eyes in `image` are smaller than the eyes in `reference_image` (relative to the face).
eyes_low_open: The eyes in `image` are less open (shorter top to bottom) than in `reference_image`.
iris_flat: The irises in `image` look flat and pasted-on, without the depth of the irises in `reference_image`.
iris_small: The irises in `image` are smaller within the eye than in `reference_image`.
lids_heavy: The upper eyelids in `image` are heavier or lower over the eyes than in `reference_image`.
whites_little: Less eye white shows in `image` than in `reference_image`.
eyes_ok: The eyes in `image` are drawn like the eyes in `reference_image`.
